WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    SUM(res.points) as total_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
with_global_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    name,
    total_points,
    (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_totals) as global_avg_points
  FROM race_totals
),
filtered_races AS (
  SELECT name, total_points, global_avg_points
  FROM with_global_avg
  WHERE total_points > global_avg_points
)
SELECT 
  SUM(fr.total_points) as sum_total_points,
  (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS NUMERIC))
   FROM results res
   JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
   WHERE r.name IN (SELECT name FROM filtered_races)
   AND res.laps IS NOT NULL) as avg_laps,
  AVG(fr.total_points - fr.global_avg_points) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_races fr

assumptions.assumption: The 'laps' field (TEXT) can be cast to a numeric type, as it contains lap numbers.
